にあたって.en: at the beginning; at the preparation

bloques.titulo: In the case of the Commission, the Commission has not yet adopted a proposal for a Council Regulation (EEC) on the protection of the environment.
texto: To say that something is done at an important time: noun + **に 際して**: **しゅっぱつ にさいして、 ごあいさつ を します** (when I leave, I say a few words of farewell).
It is used when starting or preparing for an important act: noun + **にあたって**: **しゅっぱつ にあたって、 かぞく に あいさつ します** (when starting, I say goodbye to my family).
It is not simply a more natural version of **に際して**; both are formal and the context decides.
